response.overview: Yusni (Elly Mazlein) and Yunoh (Rashidi Ishak) return with a new determination to become millionaires. However, as before, their journey proves to be not as easy as they had hoped when they become trapped in a questionable investment opportunity. Without realizing it, they have actually become victims of a suspicious scheme that may be connected to Amir (Bell Ngasri), a man they have long believed to be dead. At the same time, their neighbors, Datuk Kadir (Azhar Sulaiman) and his wife, Datin Maimon (Sazzy Falak), play an important role in helping to save Yusni and Yunoh's marriage, which is beginning to show signs of strain. Facing various challenges and trials, the couple must find ways to overcome their financial problems and strengthen their relationship again before the situation becomes even more complicated.
